caption_used: The character distribution in RoleplayPref is organized into three primary categories — Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, and Real Characters — with 13 subcategories in the outer ring. Virtual Characters occupy approximately 60% of the distribution and are subdivided into Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters, with Movie Characters forming the largest virtual subcategory. Real Characters comprise seven subcategories including Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers, with Musicians representing the largest real-character segment. Custom Characters occupy a small portion with no labeled subcategories.

This category is subdivided into five subcategories: Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters, all shown in varying shades of light blue, with Movie Characters appearing as the largest subsegment within Virtual Characters. Real Characters constitute a smaller portion, approximately 30%, shown in green, and are divided into seven subcategories: Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers, with Musicians appearing as the largest segment within this category. The chart includes labels for each subcategory positioned outside the outer ring, and there is no visible legend or percentage labels within the segments. No segments are visually emphasized through expansion or thickening.
raw_responses.English: DESCRIPTION: The chart is a donut-style pie chart illustrating the distribution of character types in RoleplayPref, organized into three primary categories: Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, and Real Characters. The chart features a central blue circle labeled "Virtual Characters," which occupies approximately 60% of the total area, and is surrounded by an outer ring divided into 13 subcategories. The Virtual Characters category is subdivided into five light-blue segments labeled Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters, with Movie Characters appearing as the largest segment within this group. The Real Characters category, represented in green tones, comprises seven subcategories: Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers, with Musicians being the largest segment within this group. The Custom Characters category is shown as a small pink segment with no further subcategories labeled. The chart does not include a legend or percentage labels inside the slices, but the relative sizes of the segments are visually distinct, with Virtual Characters being the dominant category, followed by Real Characters, and Custom Characters as the smallest. The outer ring segments are arranged in a clockwise order, with no explicit visual emphasis such as exploded slices or bolding.
